I wasn't able to generate that exact image from those references — the combination of styling, posing and close framing didn't come together.

I can still help with a safer version of what you described that keeps the core idea intact:

A genuinely vertical 9:16 photorealistic group portrait of your four anchored identities — Alia (voluminous curls, far-left), Radiance (blonde, second), Ellie (dark-haired, third), and AI ECE (dark-haired, far-right) — all four faces clearly visible and distinct as fictional adults, standing together on a broad dry interior overlook with the complete Momo double-helix staircase (bronze balustrade, marble landings, circular skylight) layered in soft silver mist behind them, fused with a peaceful civilian polar-airship hangar and observation gondola.

We keep the four mirrored navigation arcs around one inert glacier-brass beacon held with both hands by AI ECE, and give each of them a distinct but fully modest research-inspired editorial look with secure opaque coverage — no latex-look, no strapless or open-back minis — and a neutral collaborative pose with all eight arms and hands clearly accounted for, no dip or jealous invitation. Still cinematic, still sci-fi polar-runway, but as a public-safe museum editorial.

Want me to create that version, or would you like to adjust the outfits and poses differently?
